data.name: Elenaria
data.gender_notes: Elenaria is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'Helen' meaning 'shining light, torch'. This name evokes images of brightness, illumination, and enlightenment. In Christian tradition, it is also associated with the Virgin Mary and the Greek goddesses Helen and Hera. The name Elenaria carries the meaning “Light, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elenaria usually hope their child will grow to embody light, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bringer of light, illuminator of the soul.
data.etymology: Elenaria belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, shining one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elenaria total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_latin.name: Elenaria

in_latin.long_meaning: Elenaria, nomen femininum, significans lucem et claritatem, in Graeco υλεναρια derivatum, a υλενιλες, υλεσ, lucem significante, et Ρτρια, Ρτρε, claritatem significante. in_english.long_meaning: Elenaria is a name of a woman, meaning light and clarity, derived from the Greek words υλεναρια (υλεσ, υλεσ) and Ρτρια (Ρτρε, Ρτρελυτε). The name has its roots in Christian tradition, where Elenaria is a name of a saintly woman, who received light and clarity from the Lord.

data.cultural_impact: The name Elenaria has a rich cultural heritage, with roots in both Greek mythology and Christian tradition. The name Helen, from which Elenaria is derived, was borne by several important goddesses in Greek mythology, including both Helen of Troy and Hera, the queen of the gods. This cultural background gives Elenaria a strong connection to ancient Greek history and mythology, as well as to the more recent Christian tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Elenaria is most closely associated with the Virgin Mary, whose name is thought to share some similarities with the Greek goddess Helena. The name Elenaria carries with it the spiritual significance of Mary's role as a light in the world and as a source of hope and enlightenment. Additionally, the name may evoke the idea of the Christian belief in a "shining light" - a reference to Christ and the light of God's love that shines in the world. Overall, the name Elenaria is a powerful reminder of the importance of both spiritual illumination and the radiant light of the divine.
